name: fara-portfolio-site
description: Cloudflare Workers への公開用（wrangler のバージョン固定）。サイト本体は src/FaraPortfolio.Web（静的 SSR。書き出しは dist/）

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['dist','src/FaraPortfolio.Web/bin','src/FaraPortfolio.Web/obj','tests/FaraPortfolio.Tests/bin','tests/FaraPortfolio.Tests/obj']) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.publish:site: npm run clean && dotnet run --project src/FaraPortfolio.Web -c Release --no-launch-profile -- --export dist
scripts.check: npm run publish:site && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env develop
